findings.title: Yargs loaded at the root and failed at its browser entry
findings.summary: yargs 18.2.0 passed all eight root checks. Importing yargs/browser failed on all four profiles. Both Node.js versions reported an unsupported HTTPS module URL. Bun gave no usable diagnostic, and Deno gave different error codes between runs. A fresh rebuild from the retained lock matched the original dependency tree digest and repeated all four failures. This is a browser entry observed in offline server runtimes.

findings.title: estree-walker exposed an import-only root
findings.summary: estree-walker 3.0.3 loaded with import on all four profiles. Its root export provides an import condition and a type declaration. CompatLab recorded all four require cells as inapplicable, so the row contributes to the import result without counting as a require failure.

findings.title: tslib loaded at the root with incomplete subpath coverage
findings.summary: tslib 2.9.1 passed both loading modes on every profile. Its export map includes a wildcard and a trailing-slash key. The planner left those paths out and recorded the overall report as inconclusive. An application that uses another tslib path should check that exact path.
